title: Calendar
quickPlaceholder: Add an exam, a class or a task: “English test on Monday at 10”
noEventsBody: Keep the day free to review, or add something.
summary_none: No exams in the next two weeks. A good time to get ahead.
summary_one: One exam in the next two weeks: “{{first}}”, {{when}}.
summary_other: {{count}} exams in the next two weeks; the first is “{{first}}”, {{when}}.
agendaEmptyBody: Exams, assignments and classes from your courses and connected platforms will show up here.

import.skipped_one: One was already there and wasn’t duplicated.
import.skipped_other: {{count}} were already there and weren’t duplicated.

errors.too_large: The file is too large (over 10 MB).
errors.calendar_too_large: The calendar has too many events to import.
errors.calendar_too_complex: The calendar has too many repetitions to import.

sheet.courseExamNote: This is the exam of your course “{{course}}”: changing the date changes the course.
sheet.missing: That event isn’t in the calendar anymore: it may have been deleted or changed on its platform.
sheet.seriesLocked: This belongs to the whole series: choose “This and following” or “All of them” to change it.
sheet.name: Name
sheet.task: It’s a task (check it off when done)
sheet.prepareHint: Aula can help you prepare for this exam.
sheet.prepareLinked: You already have a course for this exam.
sheet.readOnlyPlatform: This comes from {{platform}}: Aula can’t change or delete it. To note something down, add an event of your own.
sheet.readOnlySubscription: This comes from your subscription “{{name}}” and updates itself. To change it, change it in the original calendar.

errors.title: Give the event a name.
errors.endBeforeStart: It ends before it starts: check the end.
errors.untilBeforeStart: The repeat ends before the first occurrence.
errors.weekdays: Choose at least one day of the week.
errors.seriesOnly: “Only this one” can’t change how it repeats, whether it’s a task or its course: choose “This and following” or “All of them”.

confirmDelete.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
confirmDelete.body: It will be removed from your calendar. This can’t be undone.
confirmDelete.bodySeries: It repeats. What do you want to delete?
confirmDelete.bodyExam: The course stays as it is; it just won’t have an exam date.

subs.title: Subscribed calendars
subs.intro: Paste a calendar link: your university timetable, your Google Calendar, public holidays… Aula checks it every hour. Its events show in your calendar, but you change them in the original.
subs.name: Name (optional)
subs.secret: The link is stored encrypted on this computer: it’s never shown or sent to your AI provider.
subs.empty: You haven’t subscribed to any calendar yet.
subs.removeBody: Its events stop showing in your calendar. You can subscribe again whenever you like.

errors.calendar_invalid_url: That link isn’t valid: it must start with webcal:// or https:// (in Google Calendar: Settings → Integrate calendar → “Secret address in iCal format”).
errors.calendar_private: That calendar is private. Use its secret address in iCal format.
errors.calendar_private_redirect: The calendar redirects to an address on this computer or the local network, and Aula doesn’t follow it.
errors.calendar_not_found: The link no longer exists or has expired. Generate a new one and paste it again.
errors.rate_limited: The calendar is limiting requests. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.calendar_server: The calendar’s server had a problem. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.calendar_http: The calendar’s server answered with an error.
errors.not_a_calendar: The link didn’t return an .ics calendar (is it the calendar’s web page instead of its iCal address?).
errors.too_large: The calendar is too large (over 10 MB).
errors.calendar_too_large: The calendar has too many events to read.
errors.calendar_too_complex: The calendar has too many repetitions to read.
errors.offline: No internet connection. You’re seeing the events from the last update.
errors.timed_out: The calendar took too long to answer.
errors.host_not_found: That server wasn’t found: check the link is spelled right.
errors.secure_connection: Couldn’t make a secure connection to the calendar’s server.
errors.network: There was a network error reading the calendar.
errors.calendar_duplicate: You’re already subscribed to that calendar.
errors.calendar_too_many: You can have up to 20 subscriptions: remove one you no longer use.
errors.calendar_missing_link: This subscription’s link can’t be found. Remove it and subscribe again.
errors.invalid_args: Check the link and the name.
